relationships.subject: JWH-175
relationships.evidence_quote: JWH-175 showed a greater affinity for human CB1 receptors than for human CB2 receptors

relationships.subject: AM-251
relationships.evidence_quote: Perfusion with the CB1 receptor antagonist 1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-5-(4-iodophenyl)-4-methyl-N-1-piperidinyl-1H-pyrazole-3-carboxamide (AM-251; 2 µM) completely prevented the inhibitory effect of JWH-175 and JWH-018 both at 1 µM

relationships.subject: JWH-175
relationships.evidence_quote: Systemic administration of JWH-175 (0.01–30 mg/kg; i.p.) dose-dependently increased the threshold to acute mechanical pain stimulus in mice

key_findings: JWH-175 is rapidly bioactivated in vivo to the more potent CB1/CB2 agonist JWH-018 in mice, and plasma JWH-018 correlates with behavioral effects.
JWH-175 is less potent than JWH-018 in CB1-mediated electrophysiological and behavioral effects including increased mechanical pain threshold.
